description: Cross-project promotion (promoteToGlobal). A title shared by 2+ projects (local, approved) whose first-200-char word-Jaccard >= 0.80 must flip ALL matching rows to scope='global'; a shared title below 0.80 must stay local. Pairs are seeded LAST so base seeding never fires a premature promotion. TP = true-dup correctly promoted; FP = distinct pair wrongly promoted; FN = true-dup not promoted.
